instruction: Set a custom service as the default systemd target in Ubuntu.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because configuring systemd targets requires root access to modify system service files and use systemctl commands with elevated privileges. The task involves system-level init system configuration that cannot be performed without root access in the OSWorld environment.
